notes.title: Let me introduce the three main characters of the game.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/fa0ca9afd004ce843eefbaf621f07e393c25a952.png[/img]
[h3][b]LION[/b][/h3]
A young man who lost his purpose due to an accident with his settlement pod. While his combat abilities are not high, he excels in survival skills. 
He explores by utilizing the scattered wreckage and abundant vegetation on the mysterious planet, making full use of his crafting abilities.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/790f7379c500dd35658ba4d1adb187033d6119b5.png[/img]
[h3][b]ARIA[/b][/h3]
A girl who supports Lion.
The real reason why she continues to support him is unclear.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/a50a88991f87c2db32b3102c988e2d7e13e8900f.png[/img]
[h3][b]SELENA[/b][/h3]
A woman somewhere on the mysterious planet. 
She is connected to Lion by the threads of fate, 
but Lion is not yet aware of this.
